data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Anemone', which means 'resurrection'. The name Bloom symbolizes new beginnings, growth, and renewal. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bloom usually hope their child will grow to embody to blossom, grow and live with faith, good character and purpose.
